organization: European Society of Cardiology / American College of Cardiology
recommendations: Initiate GDMT (Guideline-Directed Medical Therapy) consisting of four foundational classes: ACEi/ARNI, Beta-blocker, MRA, and SGLT2 inhibitor
Titrate doses of GDMT to target doses used in clinical trials as tolerated
Restrict sodium intake to < 2-3 g/day and monitor daily weights for fluid retention
Promote cardiovascular rehabilitation and regular exercise when stable
Avoid calcium channel blockers (diltiazem, verapamil) and NSAIDs due to risk of exacerbation

follow_up.action: Initiate low-dose GDMT and implement daily weight monitoring
Recheck serum creatinine, eGFR, and potassium after initiating ACEi/ARNI or MRA
Follow up for symptom titration, weight log review, and clinical status review
Repeat echocardiogram to assess recovery of ejection fraction

contraindications.condition: Prior history of angioedema or concurrent use of ACE inhibitors
contraindications.action: Contraindicated; allow 36-hour washout period after stopping ACE inhibitor before starting ARNI
Contraindicated; do not start or increase dose until patient is dry and stable

emergency_signs: Acute decompensation: rapid weight gain (>3 lbs in 24 hrs or >5 lbs in 1 week), worsening shortness of breath at rest, severe orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, confusion
references: 2023 Focused Update of the 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure
